newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Taiwan tracks locals on tech buying.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Taiwan tracks locals on tech buying.

text.p: Taiwanese global depository receipts ended sharply higher on Friday, as a continued local rally in electronic shares fuelled foreign buying, traders said.
They said investors took their cue from Taipei, where electronic shares posted gains of more than 5 percent, building on a 6.6 percent gain on Thursday.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index added 2.93 points, or 2.12 percent, to 140.85, representing a discount to the local market of 2.49 percent from 1.71 percent.
Taiwan's weighted index added 1.83 percent on Thursday.
Indian GDRs tracked local stocks to mildly lower levels on political concerns as Bihar state minister Laloo Prasad Yadav resigned but appointed his wife as his successor.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.63 points softer at 84.17, a 0.75 percent fall, with the premium over the local market at 19.89 percent from 19.24 percent.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index lost 0.87 points to 94.86 -- a 20.00 percent premium to the local market. It measures from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
Bombay's benchmark index shed 36.76 points to 4,189.81.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index rose 0.23 points to 76.36 points, a premium of 46.96 percent over the local market.
